headline: Oracle Says OpenAI Infrastructure Contract Fully Funded After Capital Raise
summary: Oracle Corp. stated its artificial intelligence infrastructure contract with OpenAI is fully funded following a final capital raise, driving shares up 3.3% in extended trading.
why: Oracle is a global enterprise software provider aggressively expanding its cloud compute capacity for generative AI developers.

impacts.name: Oracle
impacts.why: Clarification that the OpenAI infrastructure contract is fully funded eased concerns regarding capital expenditures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Confirmation that funding was fully secured for OpenAI's cloud deal alleviated investor anxiety regarding capital requirements.
